expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.r===10 && S.phi===0 && S.magneetti==='ita' && S.maa===1 && S.viivat===true && S.ruudukko===false ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: r = 10 cm, φ = 0°, N pole east, Earth's field on, field lines shown, no grid (must run before any setup)
on the axis 10 cm from the centre the magnet's field is 30,0 µT (the model's scale)
with B_h = 14 µT the needle settles at atan(30 / 14) = 65,0° east of north
total B = sqrt(30² + 14²) = 33,1 µT

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===2 && R[0].min==='10' && R[0].max==='24' && R[0].step==='1' && R[1].min==='0' && R[1].max==='345' && R[1].step==='15' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: two sliders: r 10-24 cm by 1, φ 0-345° by 15

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')].map(s=>[...s.options].map(o=>o.value).join(',')); return L.length===3 && L[0]==='ita,lansi' && L[1]==='1,0' && L[2]==='0.5,1,2' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: selects: magnet orientation, Earth's field, speed

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Heilauta neulaa' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button first; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='maa,magneetti,phi,r' && P.r.unit==='cm' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares r (cm), phi, magneetti and maa
canvas is 600x400 in the wide layout
